messages:
nina: quick heads-up — mako-q8-int8 canary is returning contract payloads that aren't valid JSON (single quotes for keys/strings) and our strict parser is dropping them -> retry storms and duplicate side-effects. sample below.
jorge: when did this start? after quant pass or after the kv/packing change? any sample responses?
nina: looks like right after the int8 PTQ sweep + a runtime kv-packing optimization. repro curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"mako-q8-int8","prompt":"produce actions","max_tokens":120}'
```
bad response (truncated):
```
{"id":"r-42","output":"{'actions': ['create', 'notify'] , 'meta': {'score': 0.93}}"}
```
so the model is emitting a Python-like repr inside the output string. our SDK's strict json.loads fails and callers hit retry budget.
rachel: ouch. that's dangerous for side-effecting endpoints. short-term we should NOT retry blindly. add a rescue path that attempts safe normalization (only if value looks like a single-quoted JSON-like blob) and emit a telemetry tag. also add metric malformed_contracts_v2.
infra-bot: Canary job 4418765432-mako-q8-int8-canary created. status: running.
jorge: agree on no automatic retries. also is this present in streaming? could be early-token decoding causing the first char to be single-quote.
nina: reproduced with both streaming and non-streaming. also seen at temp 0 and 0.7, so not purely sampling.
rachel: quick mitigation: SDK rescue snippet (prototype):
```
def try_normalize_contract(s):
    # very conservative: only transform if it matches single-quote pattern
    if isinstance(s, str) and s.strip().startswith("{'") and s.strip().endswith("}"):
        try:
            normalized = s.replace(\"'\", '\"')
            # further ensure quotes around keys/strings, then json.loads
            return json.loads(normalized)
        except Exception:
            return None
    return None
```
keep this opt-in and log full sample to telemetry.
jorge: we should also add a canary lint step that rejects any model that produces non-JSON contract > 0.5% on the sample set.
nina: temporary rollout rule: prevent mako-q8-int8 from hitting dedicated pools; route to mako-fp16 baseline for contract endpoints. I'll flip the routing rule.\rachel: long-term: instrument token-level dumps and add a detector that flags leading single-quote tokens in contract-producing sequences; maybe a runtime pre-normalizer in the serving path. also consider a tiny last-token head bias retrain, but that's heavier.
infra-bot: Incident created: #INC-2145 linked to canary job 4418765432.
jorge: also add a telemetry counter for rescue_normalizations_used and sample a few for human review. rate-limit any SDK-level retry when rescue path triggered (no retries by default).
nina: I'll run a golden-run 5k prompt diff against mako-fp16 and report contract pass delta. assigning rachel to add the canary lint and jorge to add telemetry metrics.
rachel: adding lint to canary harness now. it will fail early on >0.5% malformed contracts and dump N examples.
jorge: FYI I pushed a tiny change to the PTQ recipe we ran yesterday to avoid a tokenizer remap that might be the cause; will re-run a micro-canary.
nina: thanks. Please update this thread with the golden-run artifact and any mitigation rollouts. If we see other models with similar repr-style output, escalate to model-onboard immediately. :exclamation:
